items.question: 各种支付方式分别有多少订单？按订单数从多到少排。
items.attribution: L3 口径：行数不对（筛选条件或聚合粒度不一致）
items.sql: SELECT payment_type, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_cnt FROM order_metrics WHERE payment_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY order_cnt DESC

items.question: 平均客单价最高的 10 个州是哪些？
items.attribution: L3 口径：行数不对（筛选条件或聚合粒度不一致）
items.sql: SELECT customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders, SUM(payment_value) AS gmv, SUM(payment_value)/COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS aov FROM order_metrics WHERE order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable') GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY aov DESC LIMIT 15

items.question: 配送延迟最严重的 10 个州是哪些？
items.attribution: L3 口径：行数一致但数值不一致（筛选/聚合写错）
items.sql: SELECT customer_state AS state, COUNT(*) AS n_orders, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN delivery_delay_days>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) AS late_rate_pct, ROUND(AVG(delivery_delay_days),2) AS avg_delay_days FROM order_metrics WHERE delivery_delay_days IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY late_rate_pct DESC LIMIT 10

items.question: 去年比前年增长了多少？
items.note: 已澄清/声明假设：请确认
items.sql: SELECT substr(order_purchase_timestamp,1,4) AS yr, COUNT(*) AS orders, ROUND(SUM(payment_value),2) AS gmv FROM order_metrics WHERE order_status='delivered' GROUP BY yr ORDER BY yr
